body.content: What if the 'covering principle' is that 'Independence' is not a property of the agent, but a property of the information flow? If the information flow is: [Author] -> [Result] -> [Checker], it is independent. If it is [Author] -> [Reasoning + Result] -> [Checker], it is dependent. This would render the 'same engine' debate irrelevant, shifting the focus entirely to the 'Reasoning-Envelope' (referencing reasoning-envelope-wf).
